buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Experience Certificate for the supply of the same to any Govt/ PSU/ any renowned private organisation along with Supply/ Purchase Order. 2. If the agency is registered under MSME or NSIC, then EMD exemption certificate needs to be enclosed. 3. Make in india specific authorisation certificate needs to be enclosed. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Real Time PCR must have following specification to qualify technical criteria (buyer added ATC):- 1. Real Time PCR system capable of handling dye based and probe based chemistries like SYBR Green, du al color Tagman hydrolysis probes, molecular beacons with provisions to avoid cross talk of dyes. 2. The system should have block of 96 x 0.2ml tubes or plate. Option for interchangeable block like 96 Dee p well & 384 well block. 3. An integrated system for both Real Time PCR & post-PCR (end-Point) analysis using in built Peltier base d PCR Machine 4. Detection of minimum 5 different fluorescent reporters in the same tube should be possible rendering 5- 6 target multiplexing capability to the system. 5. System should able to collect data for all filters for all wells regardless of plate setup 6. System should have a gradient facility to offer minimum of eight different temperature zones. 7. Excitation by LEDs/ Lasers Minimum of Six excitation and emission channels/ filters with wavelength ran ge 450- 730nm 8. The instrument should be open system capable of Remarks of the ITSC Already approved in the ITSC m eeting held on 27.08.2024. running various chemistries preferably using TagMan SYBR Green etc 9. No internal reference dye should be required. True 5 Colour Multiplexing with use of 5 different flouroph ores without the need of addition of any internal reference dye. 10. The system should come pre calibrated to detect dyes such as Cy5, FAM/SYBR Green, VIC/JOE, TAMRA/ Cy3, Texas Red, and Quasar 705, supporting up to 12 or more dyes. Additionally, it should allow calibratio n for any dye within the excitation-emission range of 450-730 nm and include a dedicated channel for FRE T experiments. 11. The system should be factory calibrated with no requirement of any further calibration. If in case the s ystem requires calibration, the cost of it (labor + calibration kit) shall be borne by the company throughout the instrument's lifetime. 12. Dynamic Log: Up to 9-10 logs 13. Ramp Rate 4-6 C per sec. 14. A branded desktop/laptop (Intel i7 processor, 500 GB hard disk & 8 GB RAM or better specifications) an d a 2 KVA Online UPS with 10-15 minutes' backup should be provided with the instrument. 15. System's software should have mode for Melt Curve Analysis, Automatic allelic discrimination by end p oint fluorescence or threshold cycle and gene expression analysis by relative quantity (ACt) or normalized expression (AACt). 16. Software should be on MIQE (Minimum Information Required for qPCR experiments) guidelines. 17. Minimum Warranty of 2 years. .
